scope: Free chassis; passive pivot lock and unilateral slide stop modeled ideally. No chain-to-hook attachment constraint. Both cables are represented by equal reflected motion; load share and guide friction need independent checks. Mast uses three source-dimensioned lands. Prior filled-hull trial is preserved separately. Certain joints and equipment still require geometric/load and budget closure.
